title: P014 step 3: git rm the committed front-door-tools mirror (~5.8k files)
problem: Third step of P014, after P022 and P023: delete the generated tree for the retired k3s origin.
evidence: git ls-files gitops/prod/front-door-tools: 5,839 files on origin/main 2029d18f86
2026-10-20: git ls-files gitops/prod/front-door-tools = 6,202 on origin/main da8d86b1; PR #8591 alone changed 2,898 of them (git show --stat 971a2f67). The 10-16 'result: 0 files' did not hold.
change: Not a bare git rm. Tried 2026-10-16: deleting gitops/prod/front-door-tools makes regen --verify report 5,918 missing artifacts (front-door-tools.mjs --write is still one of its two generators) and fails gitops/tests/test_manifests.py::test_mirrored_tool_count_matches_what_the_docs_claim; kustomization.yaml also lists front-door-tools/ as a resource. So in one PR: (1) drop the front-door-tools.mjs step from regen.mjs --verify/write, (2) remove the front-door-tools/ resource and mirror-count assertions, (3) git rm the tree; keep front-door.mjs and the --headroom guard if still meaningful. The regen checklist lines stay (P023 dropped). 2026-10-20 finding: with the tree git-rm'd locally, `regen.mjs --verify` does not mention it (RETIRED_GENERATORS works), but gitops/prod/kustomization.yaml (resource + comment at ~375) and portfolio-front.yaml still mount it, gitops/tests/test_manifests.py asserts its shards and mirrored-tool count, and portfolio-validate.yml runs front-door-tools.mjs --headroom. Split: (a) find what makes venture PRs run `front-door-tools.mjs --write` (a test failing or doc line) and remove that, (b) drop the kustomization/portfolio-front mounts and test_manifests assertions for the retired origin, (c) git rm the tree plus a check that fails if it is tracked. Why (a) is not a one-liner: front-door-tools.test.mjs:1562 and test_manifests.py:1211 tell the agent to run `front-door-tools.mjs --write` because those tests compare the committed tree, so as long as it is tracked every venture merge that moves a page makes them red until it is rewritten; (b)+(c) must land together.
result: Tree git-rm'd (6,202 files) with a guard test (test_manifests.py) that fails if any file under it is tracked. Tests, regen --verify and front-door-tools tests pass without it. Verify the count stays 0 after a few venture merges.
